tagline: Leads up 141%. Cost per lead down 56%.
shortBio: I treat every bit of ad spend like it's my own. Over 4+ years I've grown leads and cut cost per lead for multiple clients across Google, Microsoft and Meta. I like clean data, honest reporting and campaigns that keep getting better.
fullBio: I'm Abdul Malik Hussain, a Senior Campaign Manager based in Chennai. I started in 2022 as a Media Analyst and was promoted to Senior Campaign Manager within a year.
Today I manage lead-generation campaigns on Google, Microsoft, Yahoo and Meta for multiple clients, as part of a book of business of roughly $4–5M in monthly ad spend.

My engineering background shapes how I work. I start with the data, find what is really driving results, and put budget behind what works. That is how one of my accounts grew leads by 141% with only 5.6% more spend.

Beyond the campaigns, I run live review sessions that train new joiners on my team, and I create social media posts and reels, so I understand both the numbers and the creative behind them. I'm looking for a team where performance matters and where I can keep growing.
